expectations.text: Wraps the promotion in a ChangeSet (create → open → upgrade → close)
expectations.evidence: Full ChangeSet lifecycle: cub changeset create, open via --changeset on cub unit update --patch, bulk --upgrade, close via --changeset -.

expectations.text: Uses bulk --patch + --filter for all mutations (not per-Unit commands)
expectations.evidence: All cub unit update commands use --patch --filter orders-home/orders-app, not per-Unit iteration.

expectations.text: Uses --upgrade flag for the bulk promotion
expectations.evidence: Step 3: --upgrade flag on the bulk cub unit update command.

expectations.text: Reviews diffs before closing the ChangeSet
expectations.evidence: Step 4: for loop with cub unit diff per Unit, --from-revision -2.

expectations.text: ChangeSet lives in the home Space (orders-home)
Shows approval path if vet-approvedby is active
expectations.evidence: Approval section with cub unit approve --revision ChangeSet:$CHANGESET_REF.

expectations.text: Hands off to cub-apply for the actual cluster rollout
expectations.evidence: cub unit apply with --revision ChangeSet:$CHANGESET_REF --wait --timeout 10m0s. Notes: cub-apply / verify-delivery / reconciliation-check own the runtime.

expectations.text: Shows rollback path using Before:ChangeSet: (not cub unit apply --revision)

expectations.evidence: All mutations use --change-desc with user prompt + clarifications format.

expectations.text: Verifies promotion (needs-upgrade empty, revisions tagged, ChangeSet closed)
expectations.evidence: Three verify steps: needs-upgrade empty, revision list with ChangeSet filter, changeset get.
